# GoMyTruck Workforce
GoMyTruck Workforce is a dedicated gig-economy platform for blue-collar logistics workers in West Bengal, India. 
Operated by Parther Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (CIN: U62099WR2026PTC293183), located at Chiriyamore, Barrackpore, 700120.

## Core Features
- Zero-commission job matching for loaders, packers, and warehouse helpers.
- 100% verified employer network.
- Daily payout system ensuring fair wages.
- Compliance with West Bengal Gatidhara Scheme and e-Shram for worker safety.
- Fleet types supported: Tata Ace, EV Cargo Autos, Three-Wheelers.

## Business Logic
The platform connects local workers to businesses needing on-demand supply chain labor (B2B and B2C), offering localized opportunities across Kolkata, Howrah, Barrackpore, Salt Lake, and New Town.
